posts.name: E.Varshini
posts.cooked:
Unfortunately, I have missed BPT-1 and BPT-3 of SC and when read the grading document, I have come to a conclusion that i have to repeat OPPE only the next term. However, my dashboard shows me 1 for OPPE and SCT Approval. Does that mean i can still give my OPPE?

The same goes with DBMS. I couldn’t solve week-7 GrPA. As per the grading document, week-7 grpa question is mandatory and if missed, they’ll put fail under OPE. Does DBMS have an OPPE? or is it just the OPE (that we do as a part of graded assigments? ). I have 1 for OPPE approval, what does that mean?

posts.name: Dev Gupta
posts.cooked:
23f2003456:

OPPE and SCT Approval

This means that your system and camera is perfect to give OPPE. Now, whether you are eligible to appear for OPPE depends on course requirements.
Hope it clears the difference.

posts.name: E.Varshini
posts.cooked: I’m trying to solve BPT-4 assignment, but the permission is denied. Is it because I did not meet the OPPE eligibility criteria? Can you tell me why…

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: If you are unable to ssh into the VM, please upload your new ssh key to the website.
